ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 white-to-black pixel ratio with high macro-level contrast between the dark central peduncle/lower fluke and the bright distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pixel mass centered around the peduncle extending upwards; large contiguous white regions at the distal ends of both lobes; high-frequency stippling/mottling at the bimodal color transitions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-amplitude peaks; notable geometric discontinuity (large semi-circular void) on the right trailing edge approximately 70% from center notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upward-curling distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular, light-colored pixels (barnacles) localized exclusively on the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-on-light linear scratches and diagonal rake marks visible on the white-pigmented areas of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant missing tissue segment/notch on the upper right trailing edge, representing a major traumatic structural alteration.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellow-brown pixel hue (biological staining) visible on the medial portion of the white pigmentation on the right lobe.
